rules.title: No flat screens
rules.fix: Wrap the screen's root-level art and text in FRAME children so at least one root child is a FRAME.

rules.title: No generic frame names
rules.fix: Rename each node called Frame, Frame N, Group or Group N to a semantic name.

rules.title: Container- naming
rules.fix: Rename the grouping frame to Container-<Content>, or to another allowed prefix or semantic section name.

rules.title: Auto-layout where uniform
rules.fix: Turn the parent of the evenly spaced sibling instances into an auto-layout frame.

rules.title: Grid where grid
rules.fix: Put the instances that form the NxM pattern under a single container.

rules.title: Component reuse
rules.fix: Promote the art or structure repeated three or more times into a component and swap the copies for instances.

rules.title: No clip content
rules.fix: Turn clipsContent off, unless the node is a scroll list or a Mask-* frame.

rules.title: Popup containment
rules.fix: Move the plate, close button, content and panels into one root-level Container-*Popup frame on column edges, above the bottom safe zone, constraints CENTER/CENTER, clipsContent off.

rules.title: No underscores
rules.fix: Replace underscores in the name with hyphens; only slice_ROW_COL cells keep them.

rules.title: Tidy canvas
rules.fix: Run tidyCanvas.js with MODE: 'tidy' on the page.

rules.title: 9-slice usage
rules.fix: Rebuild the registry-listed plate or frame background as a 9-slice instead of an image fill.

rules.title: Text style binding
rules.fix: Bind the text node to a shared text style.

rules.title: Grid style presence
rules.fix: Apply the project's layout grid style to the screen frame.

rules.title: Concentric radius
rules.fix: Set the inner shape's corner radius to max(0, r_outer - d) within 1 px.
